desc:
Welcome to Would You Rather Tower of All Countries!



Choose a country and climb through obstacles to discover outfits from your favorite nation.

Will you choose Portugal or Brazil?
Messi... or Cristiano?

Each choice grants you a new accessory, hat, and outfit as you parkour your way through the tower.

👕Dress up through crazy stages!
🔥 Unlock unique outfits from your country! 
😂 Play with friends and compare your choices! 

🏆 Reach the top and flex your favorite outfit from your country! 

👍 Like the game and join the group for exclusive rewards! 

Can you survive the tower...?
